modsH: Six ways we move the sale
name: E-commerce

hero.k: Every abandoned cart has a reason.
hero.s: E-commerce behavioural insights: we study how shoppers decide, then remove what slows them.

insights.title: Doubt beats price
insights.text: Shoppers pause on trust, not cost. Reviews, returns and delivery promises settle it.

insights.title: Too many choices, no choice
insights.text: Wide ranges stall decisions. A clear default keeps people moving.

insights.title: Extra costs feel like losses
insights.text: Surprise fees and extra steps make shoppers feel they are giving something up.

insights.title: Habit is your real competitor
insights.text: People reorder what they know. New brands must make switching feel safe.

mapH: Where sales stall, and what we change

mods.title: Consumer insight sprint
mods.text: Interviews and shopper diaries find the real doubt.

mods.title: Behavioural audit
mods.text: We score every step for trust, effort and risk.

mods.title: Conversion redesign
mods.text: Pages, product and checkout rebuilt around the audit.

mods.title: Performance media
mods.text: Message matched to intent, tested against behaviour.

mods.title: Retention and habit
mods.text: Email and automation that make reorder the default.

mods.title: Product storytelling
mods.text: Demos and film that answer doubt before it is asked.

faq.question: How long does a behavioural insight engagement take for e-commerce?
faq.answer: An insight sprint runs 4 to 6 weeks. We study how shoppers decide, then redesign and media work follow in phases, each tied to one agreed behaviour.

faq.question: Do you work with our existing e-commerce platform?
faq.answer: Yes. We work inside Shopify, Magento and custom stacks, so findings become changes on the platform you already run, without a rebuild.

faq.question: How do you measure the impact of behavioural changes?
faq.answer: Against one agreed behaviour per phase, such as add-to-cart or reorder. We agree the measure and the baseline before any work starts.

faq.question: Is shopper data kept safe?
faq.answer: We sign an NDA before any data is shared and work within your security and privacy policies.

cta.p: A 15-minute fit call. We bring a first read of where your shoppers hesitate.
